newsitem.title: USA: Maine weighs having drug store chain sell liquor.
newsitem.headline: Maine weighs having drug store chain sell liquor.

text.p: Maine liquor authorities said they are considering a plan to have a drug store chain play a role in private liquor sales.
State officials said they have had discussions with the Rite Aid Corporation about the drugstore giant taking over the state's liquor business.
Gov Angus King has proposed getting the state out of liquor sales and turning over 28 remaining state-owned liquor stores to private operators.
Appropriations Committee Co-chair George Kerr has criticized King's plan, saying he doubts privatization will save the state a reported $8 million.
